name: Jeff
shortDesc: This skull chatters eerily, gently rocking as it comes to life. It calls out a warning in a hauntingly musical voice.
body: Born of the whims of a trickster wizard, *Jeff* is born of malice and cunning. Wicked skulls crave entertainment above all else, and they do not consider their tricks to be malicious. Pretending to be a person transformed into an object or horrifying monster, giving confusing directions through a dungeon, or speaking only in rhymes are just a few tactics they seem to enjoy. A wicked skull avoids direct combat whenever possible and prefers to play mind games.
scholarQuote: Such wicked skulls seem to have been made for hundreds of year. But the way to make them appears to escape common knowledge.

name: Tainted Velociraptor
shortDesc: Its sinewy frame coils with unnatural tension, every muscle taut beneath its mottled plumage of inky black and deep indigo. Vicious talons scrape the ground with each step, and its feathers — once sleek — now jut out in ragged, uneven clumps, as though scorched by shadow. Streaks of seething violet energy pulse beneath its skin, crawling along its limbs and up its neck like veins filled with corrupted ethyria. Its eyes gleam a sickly yellow, alive with a malicious intelligence, burning with a hungry, unnatural gleam — not the mindless hunger of beasts, but something colder, calculated, and wrong. The air warps faintly around its form, and a low, almost imperceptible hum of magic seems to follow its movements — as if the creature exists partially out of phase with the world.
body: Little is known of these creatures. While it is known that some dinosaurs still roam the land, the existence of *tainted* ones remains purely theoretical. If it were to exist, it is safe to say that there little chance for someone to survive this encounter...

name: Ulnorya
shortDesc: Eight long, writhing tentacles support and propel this snarling horror's oblong body while its jagged maw reveals rows of razor teeth.
